# requires: wire
#
# download/README.md § Two endings lists ten statuses as "the source refused",
# and records that Go and Python disagreed about four of them for as long as
# both existed because no test in this repository compares one implementation's
# classification of a status against another's. This is that test. Each of these
# must end the job, and none of them may come back in the sweep.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:status-400
run A alpha
submit B size=64 digest=good src=http:status-401
run B alpha
submit C size=64 digest=good src=http:status-402
run C alpha
submit D size=64 digest=good src=http:status-403
run D alpha
submit E size=64 digest=good src=http:status-404
run E alpha
submit F size=64 digest=good src=http:status-405
run F alpha
submit G size=64 digest=good src=http:status-406
run G alpha
submit H size=64 digest=good src=http:status-410
run H alpha
submit I size=64 digest=good src=http:status-414
run I alpha
submit J size=64 digest=good src=http:status-451
run J alpha
orphans
